kinds.made_from: tools/world/head.py (recipe merge-county, encoder tinyclip-39m-16), world photos of pub/data-world and the Alachua training photos
kinds.county_bias_note: the bias to use with the county list in the county's time zone; away from it the head alone uses bias
kinds.same_label: rows that share a label are one kind: their probabilities are added before the rule combines them

fusion_note: alpha_prior and the prior's smoothing were chosen on val by tools/eval/study2.py. The kinds head, t_kind, w_kind and the rule were chosen there too, on the same wildlife photos together with a third of the `train` rows of the extra set coco-kinds (people, cats, dogs, grazing animals, rooms with nothing alive). name_at, offer_at and kind_at are set by tools/eval/shipped.py through tools/fusion/fuse.py.

evaluation.head: discriminant
evaluation.kind_head: kind rows of tools/world/head.py (recipe merge-county): the 17 old labels and 19 group rows fitted together on world photos, the Alachua training photos (weight 3) and the COCO photos (weight 10); the group rows that cannot be named well are labelled other

decision.rule: The candidate (heads fitted on the training photos under the licence rule nc, TinyCLIP 39M/16, name_at at the 92-in-100 level on val) ships unless, on the test photos, (i) its kind of eye on wildlife is worse than pocket v2's by a paired difference whose 95% interval lies wholly below zero, (ii) its kind of eye on the extra set's test photos is right for less than 96.5%, or (iii) it names a species on more than 1% of the test photos of people and rooms. The rule was set by the coordinator before the candidate was measured.
decision.why: The candidate passes all three tests, so it ships as pocket v3.

evaluation.note: The species rows are those of build 9 and are unchanged.

needs: fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`)

fitted_on.rule: Rows were fitted only on photos in the public domain (CC0, no known copyright restrictions, United States Government work) or shared under CC BY or CC BY-NC; photos under any licence with ND or SA terms were left out.
fitted_on.sources: pub/data-world and train/alachua-pre2025: iNaturalist observations (open-data files); extra/coco-kinds: COCO 2017 images from Flickr. Each row of the list gives the address and the licence.
fitted_on.not_listed: Settings (temperatures, thresholds, the county bias, the offsets of the groups) were chosen on the tuning photos of the world, Alachua and COCO sets; no row was fitted on them, and the test photos were read after the settings were fixed (tools/world/head.py, docs/tracks/head.md).
fitted_on.list_note: The list is published on the branch pub/heads-world-c1; its commit is kept by the branch pin/heads-world-c1-76739ca.

fusion_thresholds_note: Since build 21 (12 October 2026), by the owner's decision, the base app names groups only: name_at and offer_at are 2, which means never (docs/COVERAGE.md). The levels tools/eval/shipped.py set on 1803 tuning photos (val) through tools/fusion/fuse.py were name_at 0.89, the lowest level from which a named species was right at least 92 times in 100, and offer_at 0.98, the nine-in-ten level for the photos left without a name; on the test photos they named a species for 20.1% and were right for 93.3%.
fusion_kind_at_note: kind_at was set by tools/eval/shipped.py through tools/fusion/fuse.py: the lowest level from which an asserted kind was right at least 95 times in 100 on 1803 wildlife tuning photos and on 3056 extra-set (coco-kinds) tuning photos. Under it the page should say that it is not sure and offer its three likeliest kinds.

evaluation_world.report: report.json beside this slot on the run's results
